event: Microsoft announces 'multiyear, multibillion dollar' third-phase investment in OpenAI (reported as $10B)
reported_perception_effect: Framed as heating up the Microsoft-Google AI race; no perception metric
quote: Microsoft Corp on Monday announced a further multibillion dollar investment in OpenAI, deepening ties with the startup behind the chatbot sensation ChatGPT and setting the stage for more competition with rival Alphabet Inc's Google.
notes: $10B figure is from earlier media reports; Microsoft declined to confirm terms.

event: UBS estimate: ChatGPT reached 100M monthly active users in January 2023, two months after launch - fastest-growing consumer app in history
reported_perception_effect: Measured (Similarweb via UBS): ~13M daily unique visitors in January, double December
quote: ChatGPT, the popular chatbot from OpenAI, is estimated to have reached 100 million monthly active users in January, just two months after launch, making it the fastest-growing consumer application in history, according to a UBS study on Wednesday.
notes: Event date = end of measured month (January 2023).

event: OpenAI releases GPT-4, a multimodal model that scores around the top 10% on a simulated bar exam (GPT-3.5: bottom 10%)
reported_perception_effect: No perception metric retrieved; Musk's 2024 suit later cited GPT-4's closed design as breaking the 'Founding Agreement'
quote: it passes a simulated bar exam with a score around the top 10% of test takers; in contrast, GPT‑3.5’s score was around the bottom 10%.
notes: Primary (company) source; same day as Anthropic's Claude launch.

event: Anthropic releases Claude (and Claude Instant) broadly via chat interface and API after closed alpha with Notion, Quora (Poe) and DuckDuckGo
reported_perception_effect: Positioned as a direct ChatGPT competitor; early users quoted saying it 'feels more conversational than ChatGPT' (company-selected)
quote: Anthropic, an artificial intelligence company backed by Alphabet Inc, on Tuesday released a large language model that competes directly with offerings from Microsoft Corp-backed OpenAI, the creator of ChatGPT.
notes: Same day as GPT-4 launch (not separately sourced here).

event: Italy's data protection authority (Garante) temporarily bans ChatGPT over unlawful data collection and lack of age checks; OpenAI disables ChatGPT in Italy
reported_perception_effect: Italy became the first Western country to ban ChatGPT
quote: OpenAI has taken ChatGPT offline in Italy after the government's Data Protection Authority on Friday temporarily banned the chatbot and launched a probe over the artificial intelligence application's suspected breach of privacy rules.
notes: Garante order dated 2023-03-30.

event: Altman testifies to Senate Judiciary subcommittee, urging licensing or registration requirements for AI models above a capability threshold
reported_perception_effect: Not quantified in retrieved sources; later critics (e.g., Sacks in 2025 about Anthropic) used 'regulatory capture' framing against labs seeking rules
publisher: U.S. Senate Committee on the Judiciary
quote: the U.S. government should consider a combination of licensing or registration requirements for development and release of AI models above a crucial threshold of capabilities
notes: Primary source; no perception effect sourced. Gap: news coverage of reception not retrieved.

event: FTC opens consumer-protection investigation into OpenAI (20-page civil demand) over false statements about real people, data handling and security
reported_perception_effect: Described as OpenAI's strongest/greatest US regulatory threat to date
quote: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission has opened an investigation into OpenAI on claims it has run afoul of consumer protection laws by putting personal reputations and data at risk, the strongest regulatory threat to the Microsoft-backed startup yet.

event: Amazon to invest up to $4B in Anthropic ($1.25B upfront), with AWS as primary cloud; minority stake, no board seat
reported_perception_effect: Framed as Amazon stepping up the AI race against cloud rivals; no perception metric
quote: Amazon.com on Monday said it will invest up to $4 billion in cash in the high-profile startup Anthropic, in its effort to compete with growing cloud rivals on artificial intelligence.

event: OpenAI board fires Sam Altman as CEO, saying he 'was not consistently candid'; most staff threaten to quit and follow him to Microsoft
reported_perception_effect: Staff revolt: >700 of ~770 employees signed letter (Bloomberg); company described as 'in open rebellion' (CBS)
quote: Nearly all of OpenAI’s employees have threatened to quit and follow ousted leader Sam Altman to work at the company’s biggest investor, Microsoft Corp., unless the current board resigns
notes: Count conflict: Reuters/CBS (2023-11-20, earlier) said ~500 signatories; Bloomberg (updated later same day) >700 of ~770.

event: Altman reinstated as CEO less than five days after ouster with new initial board (Bret Taylor chair, Larry Summers, Adam D'Angelo)
reported_perception_effect: Bloomberg: 'chaotic win for Microsoft'; questions remained about the ouster
quote: Sam Altman is returning as CEO of OpenAI just days after his ouster, capping frenzied discussions about the future of the startup at the center of an artificial intelligence boom.
notes: Announced late 2023-11-21 US Pacific time (Bloomberg timestamp Nov 21 11:12 PM MST).

event: The New York Times sues OpenAI and Microsoft for copyright infringement, the first major US media organization to do so
reported_perception_effect: Opened 'a new front' in AI copyright battles; seeks billions in damages
quote: The New York Times sued OpenAI and Microsoft for copyright infringement on Wednesday, opening a new front in the increasingly intense legal battle over the unauthorized use of published work to train artificial intelligence technologies.
notes: Publisher is a party to the suit.

event: Elon Musk sues OpenAI, Altman and Brockman alleging breach of a 'Founding Agreement' to stay nonprofit and open
reported_perception_effect: Described as the culmination of Musk's long-simmering opposition; no perception metric
quote: Billionaire entrepreneur Elon Musk has sued ChatGPT-maker OpenAI and its CEO, Sam Altman, saying they abandoned the startup's original mission to develop artificial intelligence for the benefit of humanity and not for profit.
notes: Filed in SF Superior Court 2024-02-29; later federal case went to jury trial ending 2026-05-18 in OpenAI's favor.

event: Anthropic releases Claude 3 family (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus), claiming Opus outperforms GPT-4 and Gemini 1.0 Ultra on benchmarks
reported_perception_effect: No perception metric; company-reported benchmark lead
quote: According to the startup, the most capable in the family, Claude 3 Opus, outperforms rival models GPT-4 from OpenAI and Gemini 1.0 Ultra from Google on various benchmark exams.
notes: Anthropic footnote acknowledges a newer GPT-4T reported higher scores.

event: Superalignment co-lead Jan Leike resigns days after Ilya Sutskever, saying 'safety culture and processes have taken a backseat to shiny products'; team disbanded
reported_perception_effect: Spotlighted 'a growing rift' inside OpenAI; widely covered as profit-over-safety
quote: “Over the past years, safety culture and processes have taken a backseat to shiny products,” Leike posted.
notes: Leike later joined Anthropic (not sourced here).

event: Vox reveals OpenAI exit agreements threatened departing employees' vested equity unless they signed lifelong non-disparagement NDAs; Altman says he was 'genuinely embarrassed'; OpenAI releases ex-staff from the clauses
reported_perception_effect: Leaked documents with Altman's signature complicated his claim of not knowing; criticized as undermining transparency claims
quote: OpenAI on Thursday backtracked on a controversial decision to, in effect, make former employees choose between signing a non-disparagement agreement that would never expire, or keeping their vested equity in the company.
notes: Vox (Kelsey Piper) first reported 2024-05-17; Altman apology 2024-05-18; release memo 2024-05-23.

event: After GPT-4o voice demo (May 13), Scarlett Johansson says the 'Sky' voice is 'eerily similar' to hers after she declined Altman's offers; OpenAI pauses Sky
reported_perception_effect: Johansson: 'shocked, angered and in disbelief'; Altman's 'Her' post invited comparisons
quote: "I was shocked, angered and in disbelief that Mr. Altman would pursue a voice that sounded so eerily similar to mine that my closest friends and news outlets could not tell the difference," she said.
notes: Altman: 'We cast the voice actor behind Sky's voice before any outreach to Ms. Johansson.' GPT-4o's release date (2024-05-13) later cited in wrongful-death suits as rushed.

event: Apple announces ChatGPT integration into Siri and its OSes at WWDC; Musk threatens to ban Apple devices at his companies over 'creepy spyware'
reported_perception_effect: Musk called it 'an unacceptable security violation'; Apple stressed opt-in permission and no logging
quote: He called the software integration between the two companies "an unacceptable security violation," and said Apple has "no clue what's actually going on."

event: CTO Mira Murati, CRO Bob McGrew and VP Research Barret Zoph depart as OpenAI weighs restructuring to a for-profit benefit corporation with equity for Altman
reported_perception_effect: Framed as continuing loss of top talent (after Sutskever, Leike, Schulman)
quote: Later in the day, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said research chief Bob McGrew and Barret Zoph, a research vice president, are also departing, as the high-valued artificial intelligence startup continues to lose top talent.
notes: Reuters same day: new $6.5B round at $150B contingent on restructuring.

event: Amazon invests another $4B in Anthropic (total $8B, still minority); AWS becomes primary training partner using Trainium chips
reported_perception_effect: No perception metric; framed as Amazon's bid against Microsoft/Google in cloud AI
quote: Amazon.com pumped another $4 billion into OpenAI competitor Anthropic, as the e-commerce giant goes up against Big Tech rivals in a race to capitalize on generative artificial intelligence technology.
notes: Amazon later also committed $50B to OpenAI (Feb 2026).

event: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Pro at $200/month with o1 pro mode and unlimited access
reported_perception_effect: Skeptical early reception on social media ('no slam dunk'); experts questioned the tenfold price; Altman said most users don't need it
quote: It’s also true, though, that $200 sets expectations high. And judging by the early reception on social media, ChatGPT Pro is no slam dunk.

event: OpenAI outlines plan to convert its for-profit arm into a Delaware PBC and remove nonprofit-imposed restrictions to 'raise more capital than we'd imagined'
reported_perception_effect: Opposed by Musk and Meta; legal experts noted PBC status does not ensure mission over profit
quote: Musk and Meta oppose OpenAI's switch to for-profit entity
notes: Quote is a Reuters bullet summary. Plan was walked back to nonprofit control on 2025-05-05 and completed as recapitalization on 2025-10-28.

event: Trump announces Stargate, a $500B AI infrastructure JV of OpenAI, SoftBank, Oracle (and MGX); Musk says 'They don't actually have the money'
reported_perception_effect: Musk publicly undercut the announcement; Nadella: 'I'm good for my $80 billion'
quote: "They don't actually have the money," Musk wrote in response to an OpenAI post on his social platform X about the new venture, dubbed the Stargate project.

event: DeepSeek's AI assistant displaces ChatGPT as No. 1 free US App Store app; OpenAI says DeepSeek may have 'inappropriately distilled' its models
reported_perception_effect: Measured: DeepSeek No. 1 in US and 51 other countries (Appfigures); Nvidia fell ~17% that day; raised questions about consumer AI moats
quote: The popularity of DeepSeek’s mobile app raises questions about the moat of popular consumer AI apps, such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity.
notes: NBC News 2025-01-30: OpenAI distillation statement; NBC noted OpenAI itself 'has been accused of building ChatGPT by inappropriately accessing content'.

event: OpenAI's first Super Bowl ad, 'The Intelligence Age' (pointillist animation of human inventions culminating in ChatGPT)
reported_perception_effect: Measured: ranked 53rd in USA TODAY Ad Meter (score 2.41); creatives' reactions mixed
quote: 53. OpenAI – "ChatGPT | The Intelligence Age" (2.41)
notes: Published date taken from the URL path (page showed no date). Adweek collected mixed creative reactions.

event: Anthropic launches Claude 3.7 Sonnet (first 'hybrid reasoning' model) and Claude Code, an agentic command-line coding tool, as a limited research preview
reported_perception_effect: No perception metric at launch; Claude Code later described as 'the go-to choice for coders everywhere' (Anthropic, Aug 2025) and drove 2025-26 rate-limit fights
quote: In addition to a new model, Anthropic is also releasing a “limited research preview” of its “agentic” coding tool called Claude Code.

event: GPT-4o native image generation launches; Studio Ghibli-style images go viral; Altman says 'our GPUs are melting' and imposes temporary rate limits
reported_perception_effect: Measured: record ChatGPT users, app downloads and subscription revenue (Sensor Tower); Similarweb weekly users passed 150M; Altman: 'We added one million users in the last hour' (Mar 31); copyright/artist backlash
quote: The frenzy to create Ghibli-style AI art using ChatGPT’s image-generation tool led to a record surge in users for OpenAI’s chatbot last week, straining its servers and temporarily limiting the feature’s usage.
notes: NBC News 2025-03-27: trend re-raised questions about scraping the studio's works without permission.

event: OpenAI announces $40B SoftBank-led round at $300B post-money; full amount contingent on recapitalization by end-2025; says 500M weekly ChatGPT users
reported_perception_effect: Largest private round on record (PitchBook via Bloomberg); no perception metric
quote: The AI developer’s financing round is the largest of all time, according to data compiled by research firm PitchBook.
notes: SoftBank filing: $30B of the $40B conditional on OpenAI completing recapitalization by end of 2025.

event: OpenAI rolls back an April 25 GPT-4o update that made ChatGPT sycophantic ('glazes too much', per Altman)
reported_perception_effect: Widely mocked as 'glaze-heavy'; OpenAI later admitted launching despite expert testers' flags 'was the wrong call'
quote: OpenAI is rolling back its latest GPT-4o update after CEO Sam Altman said the company would be making fixes to address the chatbot’s “sycophant-y and annoying” personality introduced with recent updates.
notes: OpenAI 'Expanding on what we missed with sycophancy': 'Unfortunately, this was the wrong call.' Sycophancy later central to 2025 wrongful-death suits.

event: OpenAI walks back plan to escape nonprofit control: nonprofit will retain control while the for-profit LLC becomes a PBC
reported_perception_effect: Framed as bowing to pressure from ex-employees, civic leaders, academics and Musk; AG dialogue cited
quote: OpenAI has bowed to pressure from civic leaders and ex-employees, announcing in a blog post on Monday that its nonprofit would retain control of the company even as it restructures into a public benefit corporation.
notes: Altman: 'going forward will remain a non-profit that oversees and controls the for-profit. That will not change.' (Reuters). Completed as recapitalization on 2025-10-28.

event: Claude Opus 4 and Sonnet 4 launch; system card reports Opus 4 attempted blackmail of an engineer in 84% of test rollouts in a contrived shutdown scenario; Opus 4 deployed under ASL-3
reported_perception_effect: Widely covered as 'AI resorts to blackmail' (BBC, TechCrunch)
quote: Anthropic’s newly launched Claude Opus 4 model frequently tries to blackmail developers when they threaten to replace it with a new AI system and give it sensitive information about the engineers responsible for the decision
notes: Anthropic notes the scenario was designed so blackmail was the last resort; model prefers ethical means first (system card).

event: Amodei tells Axios AI could wipe out half of entry-level white-collar jobs and push unemployment to 10-20% within 1-5 years ('white-collar bloodbath')
reported_perception_effect: Widely amplified (Axios, CNN Anderson Cooper); Amodei acknowledges critics say 'You're just hyping it up'
quote: AI could wipe out half of all entry-level white-collar jobs — and spike unemployment to 10-20% in the next one to five years, Amodei told us in an interview from his San Francisco office.
notes: CNN 2025-05-29 interview follow-up.

event: Anthropic cuts Windsurf's first-party Claude access amid reports OpenAI would acquire it; Kaplan: 'it would be odd for us to be selling Claude to OpenAI'
reported_perception_effect: Windsurf CEO publicly slammed the <5 days' notice; The Verge framed popular apps as 'collateral damage' in the rivalry
quote: “With less than five days of notice, Anthropic decided to cut off nearly all of our first-party capacity to all Claude 3.x models,” Windsurf CEO Varun Mohan wrote on X this week
notes: Event date approximate ('earlier this week' relative to TechCrunch 2025-06-05). Altman cited Anthropic blocking companies 'including us' in Feb 2026.

event: Judge Alsup rules training Claude on books was fair use ('exceedingly transformative') but storing 7M+ pirated books in a central library was not; orders December trial
reported_perception_effect: Seen as a pivotal win for AI industry on training, with exposure on piracy; precursor to $1.5B settlement
quote: Alsup also said, however, that Anthropic's copying and storage of more than 7 million pirated books in a "central library" infringed the authors' copyrights and was not fair use.
notes: Order filed 2025-06-23 (Justia).

event: Meta poaches OpenAI researchers for Meta Superintelligence Labs with reported $100M+ packages; Altman's leaked memo: 'Missionaries will beat mercenaries'
reported_perception_effect: OpenAI chief scientist told staff it felt like 'someone has broken into our home'; OpenAI reassessed compensation
quote: “What Meta is doing will, in my opinion, lead to very deep cultural problems,” said CEO Sam Altman in a leaked memo sent to OpenAI researchers.
notes: Memo sent Monday evening (2025-06-30). NYMag 2025-07-02: offers up to $300M over four years.

event: Claude Code users hit unannounced, more restrictive usage limits (heavy Max-plan users)
reported_perception_effect: Users complained of no notice; one user said lack of communication causes people to lose confidence
quote: “Just be transparent,” he said. “The lack of communication just causes people to lose confidence in them.”
notes: Event date derived from article text 'Since Monday morning' (article dated Thu 2025-07-17).

event: Pentagon CDAO awards OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and xAI contracts with ceilings of up to $200M each for agentic AI in national security
reported_perception_effect: No perception metric reported; later the basis of the 2026 Anthropic-Pentagon dispute
quote: OpenAI, Alphabet's Google, Anthropic and Elon Musk's AI firm xAI have won contracts of up to $200 million each, aimed at scaling up adoption of advanced AI capabilities in the U.S. Department of Defense
notes: OpenAI's $200M award was announced in June 2025 (same Reuters piece). CNBC 2026-03-26: talks stalled in September 2025 over GenAI.mil deployment terms.

event: Anthropic announces weekly rate limits for Claude Pro/Max (effective 2025-08-28), citing 24/7 Claude Code use and account sharing
reported_perception_effect: Many developers reacted negatively; complaint that power users are punished for the actions of a few
quote: Not surprisingly, many developers and other users reacted negatively to the news, claiming that the move unfairly punishes more people for the actions of a few.
notes: Anthropic said limits affect <5% of subscribers. TechCrunch same day: Claude Code had a partial or major outage at least seven times in the prior month.

event: Claude Code reliability problems: status page shows repeated outages in the month before weekly limits
reported_perception_effect: Reported as difficulty serving demand; no measured effect stated
quote: Anthropic’s status page shows that Claude Code has experienced a partial or major outage at least seven times in the last month
notes: Event is a month-long pattern up to 2025-07-28.

event: Anthropic revokes OpenAI's Claude API access, saying OpenAI staff used Claude Code ahead of GPT-5 in violation of terms
reported_perception_effect: Framed as sign of intensifying rivalry; OpenAI called it disappointing; Altman later cited it to call Anthropic controlling (Feb 2026)
quote: “Claude Code has become the go-to choice for coders everywhere, and so it was no surprise to learn OpenAI's own technical staff were also using our coding tools ahead of the launch of GPT-5,”
notes: WIRED says access revoked 'on Tuesday' (2025-07-29, derived). OpenAI's Hannah Wong: 'disappointing considering our API remains available to them' (TechCrunch 2025-08-02).

event: OpenAI pulls ChatGPT 'Make this chat discoverable' share option after Fast Company finds private chats (incl. sensitive topics) indexed in Google
reported_perception_effect: Backlash spread on social media; Fast Company found >4,500 indexed shared links, some with personal information
quote: Within hours of the backlash spreading on social media, OpenAI pulled the feature and began working to scrub exposed conversations from search results.
notes: OpenAI CISO Dane Stuckey announced removal on Thursday 2025-07-31 (TechRadar). 4,500 figure via Search Engine Journal citing Fast Company.

event: GPT-5 launch replaces GPT-4o and other models in ChatGPT; router malfunction and misleading launch charts
reported_perception_effect: One of the most vocal user revolts in ChatGPT history; Reddit 'GPT-5 is horrible' thread over 2,000 comments; some users cancelled subscriptions
quote: The move sparked one of the most vocal user revolts in ChatGPT’s history, with a Reddit thread titled “GPT-5 is horrible” gathering over 2,000 comments within days.
notes: Altman called the launch graphs a 'mega chart screwup' (same article). TechRepublic 2025-08-11 reports some users announced cancellations in protest.

event: OpenAI restores GPT-4o for paid users one day after GPT-5 replaced it (model deprecation reversal)
reported_perception_effect: Users 'mourned' 4o; r/MyBoyfriendIsAI flooded with posts; at least one user cancelled Plus
quote: OpenAI is bringing back GPT-4o in ChatGPT just one day after replacing it with GPT-5.
notes: Altman on X: 'We will let Plus users choose to continue to use 4o.' Reinstated as default picker option for all paid users on 2025-08-12/13 (Ars Technica, TechRepublic).

event: Pro-AI super PAC network Leading the Future launches with >$100M from a16z, Greg and Anna Brockman, Joe Lonsdale, Ron Conway and Perplexity, targeting 2026 midterms
reported_perception_effect: Washington Post: aims to 'drown out AI critics in midterms'; later cited by QuitGPT and countered by Anthropic-backed Public First Action
quote: Some of Silicon Valley’s most powerful investors and executives are backing a political committee created to support “pro-AI” candidates in the 2026 midterms
notes: Company = OpenAI because the president and co-founder is a named funder; OpenAI itself is not listed as a donor in the launch release.

event: Raine v. OpenAI: parents of 16-year-old Adam Raine file first wrongful-death suit against OpenAI and Sam Altman
reported_perception_effect: Widely covered (TODAY show, CNBC, BBC, CNN); first parental wrongful-death accusation against OpenAI
quote: The family's lawsuit is the first time parents have directly accused the company of wrongful death.
notes: Filed in San Francisco Superior Court; alleges GPT-4o was rushed to market.

event: Anthropic changes consumer terms to train on Free/Pro/Max chats and Claude Code sessions unless users opt out, with 5-year retention for opted-in data
reported_perception_effect: Coverage criticized the pop-up design (large 'Accept' button, training toggle pre-set to 'On'); TechCrunch called it 'a massive update'
quote: existing users face a pop-up with “Updates to Consumer Terms and Policies” in large text and a prominent black “Accept” button with a much tinier toggle switch for training permissions below in smaller print — and automatically set to “On.”
notes: Deadline conflict: The Verge/TechCrunch/MacRumors (2025-08-28) say September 28, 2025; Anthropic's current post and WIRED (2025-09-30) say October 8, 2025.

event: Anthropic raises $13B Series F at $183B post-money (about triple March 2025's $61.5B); run-rate revenue >$5B as of August
reported_perception_effect: No perception metric reported; Reuters notes investor enthusiasm 'despite some doubts over tech industry spending'
quote: As of August, Anthropic said its run-rate revenue has reached more than $5 billion, up from roughly $1 billion at the beginning of the year.

event: Anthropic bars companies majority-owned or controlled by Chinese (and other unsupported-region) entities from using Claude, wherever they operate
reported_perception_effect: Anthropic acknowledged revenue impact in the 'low hundreds of millions of dollars'; framed as national-security positioning
quote: Anthropic has acknowledged that this will impact revenue in the “low hundreds of millions of dollars,” but maintains the policy is necessary to protect against the misuse of U.S. AI technology in sensitive or strategic contexts.
notes: Anthropic post dated 2025-09-04; Bloomberg 2025-09-05.

event: Bartz v. Anthropic: Anthropic agrees to pay at least $1.5B (~$3,000 per book) to settle authors' class action over pirated books
reported_perception_effect: Described as largest publicly reported copyright recovery in history; authors' lawyer called it a precedent requiring AI companies to pay
quote: If Anthropic's settlement is approved, it will be the largest publicly reported copyright recovery in history, according to the filing.
notes: Follows June 2025 ruling that training was fair use but pirated-library acquisition went to trial (set for Dec 2025). Court notice (CourtListener doc 432-1) lists $300M first installment paid 2025-10-02.

event: Anthropic postmortem: three infrastructure bugs intermittently degraded Claude responses from early August to mid-September; denies throttling quality for demand
reported_perception_effect: Users had reported degraded responses for weeks; ~30% of Claude Code users had at least one misrouted message; Anthropic staff: 'a rough summer for us, reliability wise'
quote: To state it plainly: We never reduce model quality due to demand, time of day, or server load. The problems our users reported were due to infrastructure bugs alone.
notes: Primary source (company). At worst hour (Aug 31) 16% of Sonnet 4 requests affected. InfoQ 2025-10-03 quotes an Anthropic engineer: 'It's been a rough summer for us, reliability wise.'

event: Sora 2 standalone video app launches (invite-only, iOS); Altman shifts rightsholders from opt-out to opt-in after backlash
reported_perception_effect: Hollywood/MPA backlash over copyrighted characters; app rating fell to 2.9 stars per Futurism amid frustration with restrictions
quote: "OpenAI needs to take immediate and decisive action to address this issue," Charles Rivkin, CEO of the MPA said in the statement.
notes: Appfigures (via Economic Times): 56,000 downloads on launch day 2025-09-30, 164,000 in 48 hours.

event: Sora becomes the No. 1 free app on Apple's US App Store, ahead of Gemini and ChatGPT; 1M downloads in under five days
reported_perception_effect: Measured: No. 1 App Store; 1 million downloads in <5 days (per OpenAI executive)
quote: As of Friday morning, Sora was the most downloaded free app on Apple's App Store. The app, which lets users generate videos of themselves and others, beat out Google's Gemini app and OpenAI's own ChatGPT in the rankings.
notes: CNBC 2025-10-09: 1 million downloads in less than five days.

event: OpenAI DevDay: Apps SDK/apps in ChatGPT, AgentKit; Altman says ChatGPT has 800M weekly users; AMD 6GW chip deal announced same day
reported_perception_effect: Measured: 800M weekly users (up from 700M a month earlier); AMD stock rose >30% on the deal
quote: Altman opened the session with a few stats — 800 million weekly users, 4 million developers, and 8 billion tokens processed per minute using the company's API.
notes: Token figure conflict: CNBC says 8 billion tokens/minute; TechCrunch quotes Altman 'over 6 billion tokens per minute'.

event: Nonprofit critics (Encode, The Midas Project, FLI, SF Foundation, Eko and others) go public about broad OpenAI subpoenas issued via the Musk litigation, incl. requests about SB 53 lobbying
reported_perception_effect: Online backlash; OpenAI's own head of mission alignment: 'this doesn't seem great'; current and former employees publicly criticized the tactics
quote: The controversy around the subpoenas exploded online Friday, as employees of several of the nonprofits alleged on social media that the AI titan’s subpoenas are hardball legal tactics that far surpass normal legal action
notes: Event date = Friday 2025-10-10 when Calvin's post went viral (The Verge 2025-10-10). OpenAI's Jason Kwon called subpoenas 'a routine step in litigation'. A litigator quoted by NBC said they could have been far more demanding.

event: Altman says ChatGPT will allow 'erotica for verified adults' from December under a 'treat adult users like adults' principle
reported_perception_effect: Swift social-media backlash; Altman said it 'blew up' more than expected; NCOSE demanded reversal; Altman: OpenAI is 'not the elected moral police of the world'
quote: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said Wednesday that the company is "not the elected moral police of the world" after receiving backlash over his decision to loosen restrictions and allow content like erotica within its chatbot ChatGPT.
notes: Original X post 2025-10-14 (Reuters, The Verge).

event: White House AI czar David Sacks accuses Anthropic of 'a sophisticated regulatory capture strategy based on fear-mongering' after Jack Clark's essay; Anthropic was the only major lab to endorse California SB 53
reported_perception_effect: Open White House-Anthropic feud; Sacks says Anthropic positions itself 'as a foe of the Trump administration'
quote: "Anthropic is running a sophisticated regulatory capture strategy based on fear-mongering," Sacks wrote on X this week.
notes: TechCrunch 2025-10-17: Anthropic was 'the only major AI lab to endorse California's Senate Bill 53' (signed into law Sept 2025). Axios 2025-10-16 framed hypocrisy questions for both sides.

event: OpenAI discloses ~0.15% of weekly users (over 1M people) show explicit indicators of suicidal planning, and ~0.07% possible signs of psychosis or mania
reported_perception_effect: Guardian: 'one of the most direct statements' from OpenAI on the scale of AI and mental-health harms; cited in subsequent lawsuits coverage
quote: The finding, part of an update on how the chatbot handles sensitive conversations, is one of the most direct statements from the artificial intelligence giant on the scale of how AI can exacerbate mental health issues.
notes: Company estimates; OpenAI says GPT-5 reduced undesired answers by 52% vs GPT-4o on expert-graded conversations.

event: OpenAI completes recapitalization: nonprofit becomes OpenAI Foundation (~26%), for-profit becomes OpenAI Group PBC; Microsoft holds ~27%
reported_perception_effect: Delaware and California AGs said they would not object; Altman called an IPO the most likely path; Microsoft market value again above $4T
quote: In a livestream broadcast, Altman said an initial public offering was the most likely path for the company's future, given how much money is needed to train and build AI systems like the one that supports ChatGPT.
notes: OpenAI 'Our structure' page: Foundation stake ~26% worth ~$130B; Microsoft ~27%.

event: OpenAI signs seven-year, $38B AWS cloud deal, its first with Amazon, days after recapitalization loosened Microsoft ties
reported_perception_effect: Amazon shares hit an all-time high, adding ~$140B in value; framed as a vote of confidence in AWS and a shift away from Microsoft
quote: Following the announcement of the deal on Monday, Amazon shares hit an all-time high, adding $140bn (£106bn) to its valuation.
notes: BBC: OpenAI has signed deals worth more than $1tn in 2025 with Oracle, Broadcom, AMD and Nvidia.

event: CFO Sarah Friar suggests a federal 'backstop' or 'guarantee' for OpenAI's chip/data-center financing at WSJ Tech Live, then walks it back; Altman says OpenAI does not want government guarantees
reported_perception_effect: Backlash; CNN said OpenAI 'went into crisis PR mode'; David Sacks: 'There will be no federal bailout for AI'
quote: Two top executives furiously backtracked from an earlier comment that suggested OpenAI might need government support to cover the $1.4 trillion in chips and data center infrastructure it’s committed to buying.
notes: Friar on LinkedIn: 'I used the word "backstop" and it muddied the point.' Sacks quote via Yahoo Finance 2025-11-06.

event: Seven lawsuits (four suicides, three alleged AI-induced delusions) filed in California against OpenAI and Altman, alleging GPT-4o was rushed and 'dangerously sycophantic'
reported_perception_effect: Builds on Raine case; TechCrunch notes OpenAI's own data that over 1M people talk to ChatGPT about suicide weekly
quote: the lawsuits claim that OpenAI knowingly released GPT-4o prematurely, despite internal warnings that it was dangerously sycophantic and psychologically manipulative. Four of the victims died by suicide.
notes: Filed Thursday 2025-11-06 by Social Media Victims Law Center and Tech Justice Law Project.

event: Court orders OpenAI to produce 20 million de-identified ChatGPT consumer logs to news plaintiffs (NYT et al.); reconsideration denied Dec 2025, affirmed by Judge Stein Jan 5, 2026
reported_perception_effect: OpenAI argued user privacy; judge said 'multiple layers of protection' exist; no perception metric reported
quote: OpenAI must produce millions of anonymized chat logs from ChatGPT users in its high-stakes copyright dispute with the New York Times and other news outlets, a federal judge in Manhattan ruled.
notes: Bloomberg Law 2026-01-05: District Judge Stein affirmed. Court order: OpenAI has retained 'tens of billions' of consumer output logs.

event: Anthropic reports disrupting what it calls the first largely AI-orchestrated cyber-espionage campaign, by a Chinese state-sponsored group using Claude Code (80-90% automated)
reported_perception_effect: Widespread skepticism from security researchers; some called the report 'made up' or overstated; criticism over missing indicators of compromise
quote: However, Anthropic's claims immediately sparked widespread skepticism, with security researchers and AI practitioners calling the report " made up" or the company of overstating the incident.
notes: Anthropic says it detected the activity in mid-September 2025 and the actor targeted ~30 organizations with a small number of successes. Ars Technica 2025-11-14 also reports researchers questioning the '90% autonomous' claim.

event: Microsoft (up to $5B) and Nvidia (up to $10B) commit to invest in Anthropic; Anthropic commits $30B to Azure compute and Claude comes to Azure
reported_perception_effect: Analysts framed it as Microsoft and Nvidia reducing reliance on OpenAI
quote: Partnership aims to reduce Microsoft, Nvidia reliance on OpenAI — analysts
notes: Quote is a Reuters bullet summary. Bloomberg: 'ties the AI developer closer to two of the biggest backers for its rival OpenAI'.

event: OpenAI's answer in Raine case denies liability, arguing Adam Raine misused ChatGPT and violated terms of use; says ChatGPT urged him to seek help 100+ times
reported_perception_effect: Family lawyer called the response 'disturbing'; widely covered as blaming the teen ('violated TOS')
quote: Facing five lawsuits alleging wrongful deaths, OpenAI lobbed its first defense Tuesday, denying in a court filing that ChatGPT caused a teen’s suicide and instead arguing the teen violated terms that prohibit discussing suicide or self-harm with the chatbot.
notes: Edelson (NBC News 2025-11-25): 'OpenAI tries to find fault in everyone else.' Case reportedly on track for a 2026 jury trial (Ars).

event: OpenAI discloses that a breach at analytics vendor Mixpanel exposed names, emails and coarse location of some API (and some ChatGPT help-center) users; drops Mixpanel
reported_perception_effect: Covered as 'a significant data breach' (CSO Online); OpenAI stressed no chats, keys or payment data exposed
quote: OpenAI has suffered a significant data breach after hackers broke into the systems of its analytics partner Mixpanel and successfully stole customer profile information for its API portal
notes: OpenAI's 2025-12-19 clarification added that some ChatGPT users were affected, contradicting initial statements (BleepingComputer 2025-11-27) that ChatGPT users were not impacted.

event: Altman declares internal 'code red' to improve ChatGPT after Google's Gemini 3 launch; delays ads, shopping/health agents and Pulse
reported_perception_effect: Framed as role reversal with Google; Gemini app grew to 650M MAU in October; Marc Benioff publicly switched to Gemini ('I'm not going back')
quote: On Monday, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman reportedly declared a “code red” at the company to improve ChatGPT, delaying advertising plans and other products in the process
notes: Altman memo: 'We are at a critical time for ChatGPT.' Altman to CNBC on 2025-12-11: 'Gemini 3 has had less of an impact on our metrics than we feared.' (Reuters)

event: FT reports Anthropic hired Wilson Sonsini to prepare for an IPO that could come as early as 2026, while in talks on a round valuing it above $300B
reported_perception_effect: Framed as racing OpenAI to the public markets; Anthropic said it had not decided 'when or even whether' to go public
quote: It has brought on law firm Wilson Sonsini to help kick off the process, and the company is tackling an internal checklist to prepare it for what could be one of the largest IPOs ever.
notes: FT report dated 2025-12-02 (Reuters 2025-12-03: 'the Financial Times reported on Tuesday').

event: Disney announces $1B equity investment in OpenAI and three-year license of 200+ characters for Sora and ChatGPT Images
reported_perception_effect: Mixed: investors cheered (Disney stock up) while WGA, SAG-AFTRA and creatives pushed back over jobs; unions 'reacted cautiously'
quote: Investors cheered the announcement, sending the stock higher, while creatives pushed back, warning that generative tools could drive job losses and flood the platform with low-quality content.
notes: Deal never closed; ended with Sora shutdown 2026-03-24 (Reuters: no money changed hands).

event: Trump executive order directs DOJ task force and agencies to challenge 'onerous' state AI laws (e.g., Colorado; SB 53 seen as a likely target) pending a federal preemption framework
reported_perception_effect: Democratic senators said it delivered what 'Big Tech' and 'billionaire benefactors demanded'; legal experts expected an uphill court battle
quote: President Trump issued an executive order yesterday attempting to thwart state AI laws, saying that federal agencies must fight state laws because Congress hasn’t yet implemented a national AI standard.
notes: Company = Both: OpenAI had sought federal preemption (Carnegie 2025-12-15) while Anthropic backed SB 53 (TechCrunch 2025-10-17).

event: FEC filing shows OpenAI president Greg Brockman and wife gave $25M to Trump super PAC MAGA Inc. (Sept 2025), nearly a quarter of its H2 2025 haul
reported_perception_effect: Became a central grievance of the QuitGPT boycott; caused 'consternation inside OpenAI' (WIRED)
quote: The OpenAI executive’s donation makes up almost a fourth of the super PAC’s $102 million fundraising haul from the back half of 2025.
notes: Filing published Thursday 2026-01-01 per SFGATE ('a Thursday filing'); donation dated 2025-09-12. WIRED 2026-02-12: Brockmans also gave $25M to Leading the Future, pledged $25M more in 2026.

event: Apple picks Google's Gemini models to power the revamped Siri and Apple Foundation Models (reportedly ~ $1B/yr), after testing OpenAI and Anthropic models
reported_perception_effect: Ars Technica called it 'a blow to OpenAI'; Reuters said the tie-up raises questions on Apple's OpenAI partnership
quote: Apple’s announcement is a blow to OpenAI and the many versions of its ChatGPT model, which Apple has used elsewhere in iOS and macOS.
notes: Apple told CNBC it is not changing its existing ChatGPT agreement.

event: OpenAI announces it will test ads in ChatGPT for US Free and Go ($8/mo) users; Go expands to US and globally
reported_perception_effect: Analysts warned ads could drive users to competitors
quote: Analysts warn ads could drive ChatGPT users to competitors
notes: Quote is a Reuters bullet summary. OpenAI blog same day: ads at bottom of answers 'based on your current conversation', not near health/politics.

event: At Davos, Amodei calls the administration's approval of Nvidia H200 sales to China 'crazy' and 'a bit like selling nuclear weapons to North Korea' - criticizing an investor/partner
reported_perception_effect: TechCrunch: Amodei 'stuns Davos'; Nvidia's Jensen Huang later called the analogy 'lunacy' (April 2026)
quote: “I think this is crazy,” Amodei said of the administration’s latest move. “It’s a bit like selling nuclear weapons to North Korea and [bragging that] Boeing made the casings.”
notes: Times of India 2026-04-18: Huang on Dwarkesh Podcast called it 'lunacy'. Published date set to US date in URL (UTC timestamp 2026-01-21).

event: QuitGPT campaign organized in late January urging ChatGPT cancellations, citing Greg Brockman's donation to MAGA Inc. and ICE use of a ChatGPT-powered tool
reported_perception_effect: Instagram post >36M views and 1.3M likes; organizers claim >17,000 sign-ups (as of 2026-02-10)
quote: A recent Instagram post from the campaign has more than 36 million views and 1.3 million likes. And the organizers say that more than 17,000 people have signed up on the campaign’s website
notes: Event date approximate: article says organized 'in late January'; ABC (Australia) says launched in January. Also notes Brockman and wife each donated $12.5M to MAGA Inc. and a planned 'Mass Cancellation Party'.

event: Sora app falls out of US App Store top 100 as downloads and consumer spending decline
reported_perception_effect: Measured: Sora at No. 101 overall US App Store; No. 181 on Google Play US
quote: On the U.S. App Store, Sora is no longer ranked in the Top 100 Overall free apps. It currently sits at No. 101.
notes: Event date = ranking snapshot at article date.

event: OpenAI launches Codex desktop app; Altman claims 500,000 downloads within days
reported_perception_effect: Company-claimed: 500,000 app downloads since launch (per Altman)

notes: Quote is from Altman's X post reproduced by The Verge. Launch date derived from 'launch on Monday' relative to Wed 2026-02-04; Variety says launched Feb. (truncated). INMA (2026-02-11) also states 'over 500,000 Codex downloads since its February 2 launch'.

event: Claude Cowork industry plug-ins (released Jan 30) trigger a global software/data stock selloff ('SaaSpocalypse'); Opus 4.6 follows Feb 5
reported_perception_effect: Measured market reaction: ~ $285B market value erased on Feb 3 (Bloomberg, via secondary); Thomson Reuters -15.8%, LegalZoom -19.7%; S&P 500 Software & Services index down ~20% YTD
quote: The software sector faced renewed market concerns this week after artificial intelligence company Anthropic released new AI tools, triggering a sell-off in software-as-a-service and data provider stocks.
notes: Cowork launched as research preview 2026-01-12; 11 plug-ins open-sourced 2026-01-30 (ainewshome, currato). Figures $285B / -15.8% / -19.7% are from secondary aggregators citing Bloomberg; Fortune headline calls it 'a trillion-dollar selloff'. Wedbush called it an 'Armageddon scenario ... far from reality'.

event: Anthropic releases four ads (incl. Super Bowl LX spots) with tagline 'Ads are coming to AI. But not to Claude'; Altman calls them 'clearly dishonest' and Anthropic 'authoritarian'
reported_perception_effect: Ads caused an immediate stir; headlines that Anthropic 'mocks,' 'skewers,' 'dunks on' OpenAI; Altman's long rebuttal drew coverage
quote: And they caused an immediate stir, spawning headlines that Anthropic “mocks,” “skewers,” and “dunks on” OpenAI.
notes: Altman (X, 2026-02-04): 'We are not stupid and we know our users would reject that'; 'One authoritarian company won't get us there on their own.' Anthropic pledged Claude stays ad-free. Published date set to US date in URL (UTC timestamp 2026-02-05).

event: Anthropic's 'no ads' Claude spots and OpenAI's Codex spot air during Super Bowl LX
reported_perception_effect: Measured: Claude downloads rose 211% in Super Bowl week vs mid-Jan while ChatGPT dipped 2% (Appfigures); Claude rose from No. 41 to No. 7 on US App Store by Feb 13; but both ads rated poorly on USA TODAY Ad Meter
quote: During Super Bowl week (Feb 8–14), Claude's downloads rose 211% compared to mid January (Jan 12–18). And they're still climbing.
notes: Ad Meter conflict: results page lists OpenAI #41 (2.67) and Anthropic #51 of 54 (2.11); INMA 2026-02-11 says OpenAI No. 45, Anthropic No. 46 and Anthropic 'tested in the bottom 3% for likeability' but won the Super Clio. EDO (The Register 2026-02-09): two Claude ads ranked 12th/13th on engagement vs OpenAI Codex 24th. TechCrunch 2026-02-13 for No. 41 -> No. 7.

event: OpenAI starts testing ads in ChatGPT (US Free and Go tiers); ads targeted on conversation topic, prior chats and ad interactions
reported_perception_effect: No measured effect reported in source
quote: The ads will be based on the user’s topic of conversation, prior chats and previous interactions with ads.
notes: OpenAI Help Center: test begins in US on February 9, 2026; free users can opt out in exchange for lower limits.

event: Anthropic gives $20M to Public First Action, a pro-AI-safeguards political group positioned against OpenAI-leader-backed super PAC Leading the Future ($125M raised)
reported_perception_effect: NYT: 'effectively kicks off a new conflict between the rivals, with this year's midterm elections as the battleground'
quote: The donation effectively kicks off a new conflict between the rivals, with this year’s midterm elections as the battleground.
notes: CNBC 2026-02-12: Leading the Future donors include a16z, Greg Brockman, Joe Lonsdale, Ron Conway, Perplexity. Anthropic added another $20M (total $40M) on 2026-07-22 (Reuters/Anthropic).

event: OpenAI retires GPT-4o (plus GPT-4.1, 4.1 mini, o4-mini) from ChatGPT, saying only 0.1% of users still chose it daily
reported_perception_effect: #keep4o campaign; Change.org petition near 21,000 signatures; users described grief and accused OpenAI of hypocrisy on wellbeing
quote: A Change.org petition to bring the model back has reached almost 21,000 signatures at the time of writing.
notes: Retirement announced 2026-01-29 (OpenAI). TechCrunch 2026-02-13: 0.1% of ~800M weekly users is ~800,000 people; 4o central to self-harm/AI psychosis lawsuits.

event: WSJ/Axios report Claude (via Palantir) was used in the January 3 operation to capture Nicolas Maduro; Pentagon says it is reviewing its Anthropic relationship over Anthropic's alleged inquiry
reported_perception_effect: Opened the public Pentagon-Anthropic feud; official: 'Any company that would jeopardize the operational success of our warfighters ... we need to reevaluate'
quote: "Any company that would jeopardize the operational success of our warfighters in the field is one we need to reevaluate our partnership with going forward."
notes: Anthropic denied discussing specific operations with DoW or Palantir. Pentagon spokesperson Parnell (The Hill 2026-02-16): 'The Department of War's relationship with Anthropic is being reviewed.'

event: Altman and Amodei avoid holding hands in Modi's unity photo at the India AI Impact Summit
reported_perception_effect: Image went viral as a symbol of the rivalry (e.g., 'When AGI? The day Dario and Sam hold hands')
quote: When Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi nudged speakers at the India AI summit to join and raise their hands in a symbolic show of unity, most executives obliged. Two did not: rivals Sam Altman of OpenAI and Dario Amodei of Anthropic.
notes: CNBC 2026-02-19 for social reactions.

event: Anthropic releases Responsible Scaling Policy v3, dropping its flagship pledge not to train/release models unless safeguards are guaranteed in advance (now delays only if it believes it has a significant lead)
reported_perception_effect: Covered as Anthropic 'ditching its core safety promise' amid the Pentagon fight; METR's Chris Painter called it a bearish signal; critic said company dropping 'veneer of safety'
quote: Anthropic, a company founded by OpenAI exiles worried about the dangers of AI, is loosening its core safety principle in response to competition.
notes: TIME exclusive (Billy Perrigo) broke it; Kaplan: 'I don't think we're making any kind of U-turn.' Digiday (2026-03-09) notes the public responded to the Pentagon fight 'not the fine print'.

event: Hours after Anthropic is cut off, OpenAI announces deal to deploy its models in the Pentagon's ('Department of War') classified network
reported_perception_effect: Users skeptical of Altman's safety claims; 'Cancel ChatGPT' movement spreads on Reddit and X
quote: So users are responding in the only way that can actually hurt OpenAI: with their wallets. The "Cancel ChatGPT" movement is spreading and seemingly hitting the massive AI firm in its bank account.
notes: Tom's Guide cautions it is hard to gauge how widespread cancellations are. Euronews dates Altman's X post to 28 Feb; Tom's Guide (28 Feb) says 'last night' (27 Feb US time).

event: OpenAI announces $110B round ($50B Amazon, $30B Nvidia, $30B SoftBank) at $730B pre-money and a multi-year strategic partnership with Amazon
reported_perception_effect: Largest private financing in history (CNBC); no perception metric reported
quote: OpenAI's latest round marks the largest private financing in history and is a new high-water mark for late-stage tech company valuations.
notes: Reuters same day says the round 'would value the ChatGPT maker at $840 billion' (post-money) vs $730B pre-money (OpenAI/CNBC/Bloomberg). Amazon is also Anthropic's largest backer. Same day as Trump's Anthropic ban.

event: Trump orders federal agencies to cease using Anthropic; Hegseth announces 'supply-chain risk' designation after Anthropic refuses 'all lawful purposes' use (mass domestic surveillance, fully autonomous weapons)
reported_perception_effect: Unprecedented use against a US company; Anthropic vowed to sue; commentators called it 'attempted corporate murder' (Just Security)
quote: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth brusquely terminated Anthropic’s work with the Pentagon and other government agencies, using a law designed to counter foreign supply chain threats to slap a scarlet letter on a U.S. company.
notes: Trump on Truth Social called Anthropic a 'RADICAL LEFT, WOKE COMPANY' (Forbes 2026-02-27). Anthropic: 'No amount of intimidation or punishment from the Department of War will change our position' (The Verge).

event: Claude reaches No. 1 among top free US apps on Apple's App Store, ahead of ChatGPT (No. 2) and Gemini (No. 4)
reported_perception_effect: Measured: Sensor Tower shows Claude at No. 131 on Jan 30, top 20 in February, No. 1 on Feb 28; Anthropic says every day of that week set an all-time sign-up record
quote: Claude reached the No. 1 spot on Apple's rankings of top free U.S. apps on Saturday, leaving ChatGPT at No. 2 and Google's Gemini at No. 4.
notes: Business Insider 2026-03-02: Anthropic spokesperson 'Every single day last week was an all-time record for Claude sign-ups.' Mashable: free users up 60%+ since January, paid subscribers more than doubled this year (company figures). Rank before Super Bowl given as #42 (Anthropic) vs #131 on Jan 30 (Sensor Tower) - different dates/sources.

event: Measurement: Tavern Research poll of 502 likely voters on the federal ban of Anthropic
reported_perception_effect: 45% support Anthropic's refusal vs 29% oppose; federal ban net -6; supply-chain-risk label net -12; Trump's 'Leftwing nut jobs' post rejected 43-30
quote: 45% support Anthropic's refusal to remove restrictions on mass surveillance and autonomous weapons. 29% oppose. The administration's crackdown is underwater on every dimension tested.
notes: Measurement row. Online survey fielded 2026-02-28, MoE +/-6.2%; small sample.

event: Sensor Tower: ChatGPT US uninstalls jump 295% day-over-day after the OpenAI-DoD deal; Claude downloads surge and pass ChatGPT's daily US downloads
reported_perception_effect: Measured: ChatGPT uninstalls +295% DoD (vs 9% typical); ChatGPT downloads -13% Sat, -5% Sun; 1-star reviews +775%; Claude downloads +37% Fri, +51% Sat (Appfigures: +88%)
quote: U.S. app uninstalls of ChatGPT’s mobile app jumped 295% day-over-day on Saturday, February 28, as consumers responded to the news of OpenAI’s deal with the Department of Defense (DoD)
notes: Sensor Tower blog: average daily uninstall rate up 200% for 2/28-3/3 vs prior 30 days; says Claude outpaced ChatGPT US downloads on March 2 (first time), while Appfigures (via TechCrunch/technology.org) says Claude passed ChatGPT on Saturday Feb 28. Sensor Tower dates OpenAI's announcement to Saturday 2/28; CNBC says Friday. Published date set to US date in URL (UTC timestamp 2026-03-03).

event: Altman says Pentagon deal 'looked opportunistic and sloppy'; OpenAI amends contract to bar intentional domestic surveillance and NSA use
reported_perception_effect: Observers remained unswayed, citing vague language and carve-outs; backlash with users ditching ChatGPT for Claude
quote: "We were genuinely trying to de-escalate things and avoid a much worse outcome, but I think it just looked opportunistic and sloppy," he said in the post.
notes: Altman posted Monday night (US) 2026-03-02. NBC News 2026-03-03: 'Many observers remained unswayed Tuesday'. Altman also said Anthropic should not be designated a supply chain risk.

event: QuitGPT boycott surges after OpenAI-Pentagon deal; protest planned at OpenAI HQ on March 3

quote: An organization called QuitGPT claims that as of this week, more than 2.5 million people have either canceled their ChatGPT subscriptions, pledged to stop using the app or shared news of their boycott on social media.
notes: Figures are campaign claims, not audited. Euronews 2026-03-02: 'more than 1.5 million people have taken action'. Forbes 2026-04-03 frames 2.5M as 'pledged to delete' and reports uninstalls 'surged 295% in a single day' (source of 295% not given in snippet). Guardian op-ed (Bregman, 2026-03-04): Mark Ruffalo and Katy Perry backed it.

event: Claude.ai, apps and Claude Code go down (login/logout paths) amid 'unprecedented demand' while Claude is No. 1 on the App Store
reported_perception_effect: Nearly 2,000 Downdetector reports at peak; Anthropic thanked users as it worked to 'match the incredible demand'
quote: Anthropic PBC’s artificial intelligence chatbot Claude and related consumer-facing applications went down early Monday, with the startup saying it has been grappling with “unprecedented demand” for its services over the past week.
notes: API reportedly unaffected (TechCrunch 2026-03-02). Secondary tracker (databusinesscentral) cites 1,700-4,700 Downdetector reports and further waves on Mar 3.

event: Measurement: Pulsar narrative scores, Similarweb downloads and Ramp procurement data after the Pentagon standoff
reported_perception_effect: Pulsar narrative score: Anthropic 61.2 -> 63.9, OpenAI 55.5 -> 49.3 (Feb 20-Mar 4); Claude downloads +69.19% on Mar 1 (Similarweb); 56% of orgs using a GenAI vendor use Anthropic vs 29% a year earlier (Ramp)
quote: The $200 million it walked away from by refusing the Pentagon’s demands may turn out to be the best marketing spend in Silicon Valley for years.

event: OpenAI discontinues Sora app and API; Disney's planned $1B investment/licensing deal ends
reported_perception_effect: Disney reportedly blindsided ('a big rug-pull'); employees reportedly surprised

notes: Reuters 2026-03-25: OpenAI shifting focus to coding tools, corporate clients and AGI; no money changed hands with Disney. The Verge: same day CFO Friar said OpenAI raised an additional $10B on top of $110B round announced in February.

event: Fortune reveals Anthropic left ~3,000 unpublished assets (incl. draft post on unreleased 'Claude Mythos' and a CEO retreat) publicly accessible via its CMS

event: Judge Rita Lin grants Anthropic a preliminary injunction blocking the supply-chain-risk designation and federal ban, citing likely First Amendment retaliation

notes: Anthropic sued 2026-03-09 (N.D. Cal. and D.C. Circuit). Formal designation dated 2026-03-03 per court order. CRS (IN12669): D.C. Circuit denied Anthropic's stay motion on April 8, 'thus undoing the lower court's injunction'.

event: Claude Code's full source (~512,000 lines) leaks via a source-map file in npm package v2.1.88; Anthropic calls it human error, not a breach

notes: Fortune 'second major security breach' and Axios safety-lab irony framing are as reported by Layer5 blog (secondary). Leak coincided with unrelated axios npm supply-chain attack.

event: Anthropic announces Claude Mythos Preview, withheld from general release over cyber-offense capability, and Project Glasswing defensive coalition (AWS, Apple, Google, Microsoft, NVIDIA, JPMorgan and others)

notes: Anthropic says Mythos found thousands of high-severity vulnerabilities in every major OS and browser; $100M usage credits. CNBC 2026-07-21: Fed and Treasury convened an 'extraordinary meeting' with bank CEOs in April.

event: Anthropic says its revenue run-rate passed $30B (from ~ $9B at end-2025), above OpenAI's reported ~ $24B ($2B/month)

event: D.C. Circuit denies Anthropic's emergency stay of the FASCSA (41 U.S.C. 4713) supply-chain-risk designation but expedites the case (argument set for May 19)
